title: An eight loop amplitude via antipodal duality
claim: Eight-loop planar six-particle MHV amplitude from the eight-loop three-point form factor via antipodal duality on a 2d parity-preserving surface, lifted to 3d kinematics and promoted to a function with few ambiguities; passes near-collinear, multi-Regge, factorization, self-crossing and origin checks.

assumed: antipodal duality at eight loops (validated a posteriori by limit checks)
checked_partially: near-collinear, multi-Regge, factorization, self-crossing, origin limits

cross_checks: S1b.19; used as lower-order check in S1b.17
notes: Direct predecessor of the nine-loop result (S1b.17).
